name: suite-query-execution
body: The opencode suite tools' execution of graph queries on behalf of an agent: a tool shells out to `apg query` and consumes the result, which is either CSV rows or a failure (the `apg query failed (exit N): …` message, or the missing-DB message). A query attempt therefore has two outcomes — data or error — and the error outcome must be surfaced to the caller verbatim rather than parsed as data. This is the narrow domain behaviour behind the suite-tools-surface-query-failures requirement, distinct from the whole agent suite.
